text.autoconfig.qubitsaaatweaks.title: Qubit's AAA Tweaks Config
text.autoconfig.qubitsaaatweaks.option.b: Controls when the post-processing bloom pass is active for AAAParticles effects.
Mod namespaces excluded from particle bloom (e.g. 'modid').
text.autoconfig.qubitsaaatweaks.option.p: Pre-initialize Effekseer effects during resource reload to eliminate first-spawn frame stutters.
text.autoconfig.qubitsaaatweaks.option.s: Skip Effekseer world/hand passes and fullscreen depth blits when no emitters of that type are active.
text.autoconfig.qubitsaaatweaks.option.l: Only copy the fullscreen color attachment into DISTORTION_BACKGROUND when an active emitter uses a distortion texture.
text.autoconfig.qubitsaaatweaks.option.s: Bypass redundant glGetInteger and glPixelStorei polling during per-frame Effekseer draw calls.
